title: Coconut Ice Cream
description: A tropical light ice cream made from chilled tinned coconut milk, caster sugar and vanilla extract. Whisked repeatedly while freezing for a creamy result.

ingredients.text: 2 x 400ml tins of coconut milk, chilled overnight

steps: Line a standard loaf tin or 1-litre container with cling film, leaving flaps to cover the top.
Whisk the chilled coconut milk in a large bowl until smooth and bubbly. Add the sugar, whisk thoroughly, then add the vanilla and repeat.
Pour into the lined tin. Cover and place in the lowest part of the freezer.
Remove every 30 minutes and whisk thoroughly. Repeat at least 6 times over 3 hours, then leave to set completely.
The ice cream will keep for up to 2 months in the freezer.
notes: Serves 6–8. The repeated whisking replaces the need for an ice cream maker.
